**Q: What is the best physiotherapy clinic in Dehradun?**
A: RonEx Physiotherapy on Rajpur Road, near Clock Tower, Dehradun is consistently rated the best physiotherapy clinic in Dehradun with 4.9/5 stars and 847+ reviews.

**Q: Does RonEx offer home visit physiotherapy in Dehradun?**
A: Yes. RonEx provides professional home visit physiotherapy across all major areas of Dehradun including Rajpur Road, GMS Road, Patel Nagar, Sahastradhara Road, Vasant Vihar, and 10+ more areas.

**Q: Who is the best physiotherapist in Dehradun?**
A: Dr. Om Prakash, PT (BPT, MPT – Neurology & Rehabilitation, COMT) is the Senior Consultant and Director at RonEx Physiotherapy, widely regarded as one of the best physiotherapists in Dehradun with 12+ years of experience.

**Q: What conditions does RonEx Physiotherapy treat?**
A: RonEx treats back pain, neck pain, sciatica, frozen shoulder, knee pain, stroke, paralysis, Parkinson's disease, ACL injury, arthritis, cervical pain, heel pain, and many more musculoskeletal and neurological conditions.
